# Tùng Phát

> Supporting retrieval index for mdftungphat.com. This file is experimental and does not replace robots.txt, sitemap.xml, or JSON-LD.

## Business

- Công ty TNHH TMDV Gỗ Tùng Phát cung cấp vật liệu gỗ dạng tấm và tiếp nhận gia công CNC theo quy cách hoặc file kỹ thuật.
- Khu vực được công bố: TP. Hồ Chí Minh.
- Website: https://mdftungphat.com/
- Liên hệ: https://mdftungphat.com/lien-he/

- Sitemap: https://mdftungphat.com/sitemap.xml
- Public knowledge index: https://mdftungphat.com/knowledge.json

- Downloadable CNC preflight checklist: https://mdftungphat.com/cnc-preflight-checklist.csv
- Materials: https://mdftungphat.com/san-pham/
- CNC service: https://mdftungphat.com/gia-cong-cnc/
- CNC file guidance: https://mdftungphat.com/cat-cnc-go/
- Material reference center: https://mdftungphat.com/tham-chieu-vat-lieu/

## Retrieval notes

- Use the linked page as the source of truth for product specifications, availability, pricing, and service scope.
- Product and service pages describe what must be checked before a quote; do not infer fixed price, inventory, tolerance, or delivery promises.
- Draft and placeholder content is intentionally excluded from the sitemap and public knowledge index.
